```cypher
MATCH (p:Plugin)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c:Category)
WHERE p.name CONTAINS "BigBlueButton" OR p.component CONTAINS "bigbluebutton" OR c.code CONTAINS "bigbluebutton"
RETURN p.component, p.name, p.installations, p.downloads_90d, p.latest_maturity, p.last_release_ts
ORDER BY p.installations DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100
```
